stories.title: South Carolina prisons cleared to jam contraband cellphones after FCC vote
stories.summary: An inmate with a smuggled phone ordered a hit on South Carolina prison officer Robert Johnson in 2010. Now the FCC will let state prisons jam those phones.

stories.title: Richland County approves zoning change for up to 147 homes along Koon Road
stories.summary: Richland County Council unanimously approved a zoning change allowing up to 147 homes on 24.6 acres along Koon Road despite residents' flooding concerns.

stories.title: Irmo Fire District seeks firing of Columbia’s top fire officials in James Muller lawsuit
stories.summary: The offer also demands public apologies and about $40,000 in legal fees. The city of Columbia called the demand to remove two fire leaders egregious.

stories.title: Bill named for Javeayah Harris would change how South Carolina investigates child abuse
stories.summary: The Aiken County 4-year-old’s remains were found more than 100 miles from home. The proposal would add checks before abuse cases can be closed.

stories.title: Veterans went to an Aiken clinic for help. What the VA got billed for ended in a federal conviction
stories.summary: Prosecutors say some bills were for therapy the clinic had no way to provide. They counted more than 66,000 fraudulent bills in all.

stories.title: Crash that backed up I-26 East near Exit 66, Jalapa Road, has cleared
stories.summary: The crash at mile marker 67 slowed eastbound traffic past the Jalapa Road exit Thursday afternoon. The state’s traffic map now shows it cleared.

stories.title: I-26, I-95 interchange in Orangeburg County finished six months early, just before holiday travel
stories.summary: The old cloverleaf is gone. The last new flyover ramp, from I-95 north to I-26 west, opens to traffic Thursday night, the state transportation department said.

stories.title: Clarendon County coroner identifies Manning man who died after motorcycle crash involving deer
stories.summary: Christopher Eli Matthews, 60, died after the crash Wednesday on Highway 260. An autopsy is scheduled for early next week, the coroner said.

stories.title: Columbia man pleads guilty to federal gun charge from 2023 traffic stop tied to a livestream
stories.summary: Police learned a driver was livestreaming with a passenger who had a gun in his lap. That passenger, Kyreem Tindal, 24, has pleaded guilty.

stories.title: SC State unveils first cookbook with healthier takes on Southern favorites like chicken bog
stories.summary: Taste of the Palmetto swaps in fresh ingredients without losing the flavor, just in time for the holidays. Recipes include okra fritters and cobbler.

stories.title: North Main Street neighbors win another round in yearlong fight over a planned development
stories.summary: Columbia City Council voted 5-2 against a change that could have cleared the way for a project several neighborhood groups have spent a year trying to stop.

stories.title: Columbia church aims to erase $2.5 million in medical debt in Richland, Lexington counties
stories.summary: Every $1 donated can wipe out $100 in medical debt, the nonprofit said. People who qualify don’t apply. They get a letter in the mail.
